business.what: Ride-control maker (shock absorbers, struts, front forks; 500+ models) for two- and three-wheelers, cars/UVs, commercial vehicles and railways, sold to OEMs (88% of revenue) and the aftermarket (12%). Global top-10 shock-absorber maker (ICICI Securities). Part of the Anand Group (promoter Asia Investments Pvt Ltd). Since the 2026 scheme it also owns Anchemco's fluids business (diesel exhaust fluid, coolants, brake fluids) and stakes in group JVs; since Sep-2026, 28.99% of HL Mando Anand (brakes, steering, suspension) and ~30% of HL Klemove India (ADAS).

business.ev2wShare: ~57% market share in shock absorbers for electric two-wheelers (Choice, 22-Jul-2026).
business.exportsPct: 3-4% of standalone revenue (Q1FY27 deck slide 13); target 10% 'in the coming timeline' (Q1FY27 call).
business.group: Anand Group target: Rs50,000 cr group revenue by 2030 with Gabriel as the 'primary growth vehicle and business consolidation platform' (Q1FY27 call). After Rise ~58% of group sales sat in Gabriel; after Jupiter ~70% (Group CEO, Q1FY27 call).

guidance.text: Standalone ~Rs190 cr in FY26; Rs160-190 cr in FY27 to keep asset turns (CFO, Q4FY26 call). Expansions at Hosur, Khandsa (Gurgaon), Sanand (Q1FY27 call).
Debt for the two Jupiter deals ~Rs800-1,000 cr ('total debt for approval ~Rs1,600 cr'); debt/equity ~1:1 after both close vs <0.1-0.2 now (Q1FY27 call).
Target 10% of revenue (shock absorbers, solar dampers, e-bikes).
Remaining ~30% of group businesses may come into Gabriel 'at the appropriate time'; no timeline (call).
No shortfall vs budget for FY27 despite the Q1 disruption (call).

corporateActions.event: Board approves the composite scheme ('Project Rise'): Anchemco merges into AIPL (appointed 1-Apr-2025), AIPL's automotive undertaking demerges into Gabriel (appointed 1-Apr-2026).
Stock re-rates on the scheme: Rs667 (27-Jun-2025) to Rs951 (4-Jul-2025) weekly close (Screener).
Jinhap Gabriel (51%, fasteners) and SK Enmove Gabriel (49%, lubricants) start.
3,35,86,083 shares allotted to AIPL's shareholders (record date 29-May-2026): 17,72,30,023 shares.
Project Jupiter: 28.99% of HL Mando Anand from AIPL for Rs2,231 cr (1.44 cr shares at Rs1,305.89 + Rs350 cr cash); ~30% of HL Klemove India for US$98.44 mn (75% at closing, 25% within 18 months).
AGM approves the preferential issue to AIPL.
JVA and SPA with HL Klemove executed (37,844,999 shares).
CRISIL assigns AA+/Stable to the Rs1,000 cr NCDs; bank lines reaffirmed.
Rs1,000 cr senior unsecured NCDs allotted: 8.15% annual coupon, maturity 10-Sep-2029.
1,44,04,204 shares allotted to AIPL at Rs1,305.89 (Rs1,881.03 cr): 19,16,34,227 shares; AIPL 42.67% to 46.98%.

accounting.auditor: Price Waterhouse Chartered Accountants LLP (second five-year term).
accounting.pooling: Scheme accounted for by pooling of interests (Ind AS 103 Appendix C): FY26 restated; restated Q1FY26 and Q4FY26 figures of the undertaking were not reviewed by the auditor (results note 1).
accounting.jupiterAccounting: HL Mando Anand bought from the promoter at a negotiated value (KPMG/BDO: Rs463.5 per HMAI share, 50% DCF, 50% EV/EBITDA comparables; Gabriel at the SEBI floor price Rs1,305.89). Equity value implied for 100% of HMAI ~Rs7,696 cr = 21.5x FY26 PAT.
accounting.exceptional: FY26 Rs15.25 cr labour-code past-service charge (consolidated).
accounting.relatedParty: Promoter sold a 28.99% stake to the listed company for shares and cash; the AGM approved it (19-Aug-2026).
